Name: Ayam Cemani Chickens - Void Chicken Replacement
Author: Rubecula
Description:
Replaces the void chicken's sprites, as well as void egg/void mayo items, with [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayam_Cemani]Ayam Cemani[/url] chickens. The Ayam Cemani is a hyperpigmented chicken breed, entirely black down to its internal organs. Regardless, it lays pinkish-cream eggs, not black.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

v1.1: Sell price of Ayam Cemani eggs raised to be the same as that of a large egg. Ayam Cemani mayonnaise no longer edible.
